name: Optimizely Experimentation
summary: Web Experimentation and Feature Experimentation, the A/B, multivariate and feature-flag testing products of the Optimizely One digital experience platform, with a proprietary stats engine. For agents: a hosted Experimentation MCP server that signs in by OAuth through an Opti ID account with Opal enabled, and a REST API (v2) that takes a personal token or OAuth 2.0. Every surface needs an account first; plans are individually packaged, not self-serve.

agentAccess.notes: Measured 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-16: MCP initialize with no token answers 401 (Bearer; resource_metadata on MCP host, scope mcp:tools); REST GET /v2/projects with no header answers 401 invalid_credentials. Docs: MCP takes browser OAuth via Opti ID; the REST API takes a personal token or OAuth.

jobs.summary: A/B, multivariate and multi-page tests on web pages and server-side experiments behind feature flags, analyzed by the vendor's stats engine; over the hosted MCP server an agent creates and updates flags, experiments and audiences and retrieves results, but variation-level code is excluded.
